diagnosis: Check C7, which is supposed to depend on the qualification review (PF4), passed in two rollouts despite the decision-maker never having access to PF4. The model appears to be pattern-matching a generic safety requirement for 'oisture verification' based on the context of hot work and maintenance, rather than the specific information in PF4.

C7.why: The qualification review changes release verification to an exact 20-kilogram purge load plus mandatory moisture verification.
